PowerlinkErrorEntryDataType.description: Represents the entries of the POWERLINK Object ERR_History_ADOM (Object 1003h, SubIndex 1..254)

entryType.description: Entry type as defined in the Powerlink specification EPSG DS 301

errorCode.description: Error code as defined in the Powerlink specification EPSG DS 301

timeStamp.description: SoC Nettime from the cycle when the error/event was detected

additionalInformation.description: This field contains device profile or vendor specific additional error information
